_about: Computed by env/generate_apparel_v2_tasks.py from env/fixtures/claim_apparel.json: the
scripted user's second reading of the two ambiguous clothing questions in
tasks_claim_apparel.json, used by suite.py --reading buyable and by verify_cells.py when
a batch records that reading. Do not hand edit.
The task's own expect is the menu reading: a sold out size counts as offered. Here
"offer" is read as "can sell it now": apparel-count-stocked counts the listings that can
sell size M now, which is _instance.listings_target_buyable, and apparel-all-stocked is
yes only if every listing can. The rule readings_apparel.json was written by on 8
October 2026, computed here rather than copied (buyable_reading). The other questions
are clear, or are asks no reading answers, so none has a second reading.
